# SSMS.JK — house coverage rates it BUY

Signal: the South Research division published coverage (v2) with a 12-month target of Rp1,407.0 against Rp960.0 (expected total return 62.1%). Why now: the rating crossed the BUY band on the engine's probability-weighted target.

Archetype guess: commodity_capex_turnaround · method card: per fund record routing for Plantations (palm oil).

- The November 2026 cut in total CPO export levy and duty from USD308.27 to USD246.36/t (news 2026-11-06, flagged material) is absent from the report, and the model holds realisation at 0.95 with no sensitivity to it. At 1
- The deletion is described as 'a scheduled passive seller still to clear' and argued away on liquidity: IDR11.3bn ADV 'across a full year'. Index deletions execute on one effective date, and at IDR11.3bn/day this stock tu
